Marla / Kanal Land Area Converter

This marla to kanal converter handles every land unit used in Pakistan property dealing. Enter any value, choose its unit, and get Marla, Kanal, square feet, square yards (gaj), square metres and acres in one table.

🔒 Your files never leave your device.

How to use

  1. Type the area you know, for example 10 in Marla.
  2. Choose the unit of that value from the list.
  3. Press Convert and read every other unit in the result table.

How it works

All conversions go through square feet: 1 Marla = 272.25 sq ft, 1 Kanal = 20 Marla (5,445 sq ft), 1 Acre = 8 Kanal, 1 square yard = 9 sq ft and 1 square metre = 10.7639 sq ft. Note: in a few areas a smaller Marla of 225 sq ft is used locally — if your documents use that standard, confirm with your local records.

Worked example: Example: 1 Kanal = 20 Marla = 5,445 square feet = 605 square yards = about 505.86 square metres.

Frequently asked questions

How many Marla are in one Kanal?

There are exactly 20 Marla in 1 Kanal, using the standard Marla of 272.25 square feet.

How many square feet are in one Marla?

One standard Marla is 272.25 square feet (16.5 × 16.5 feet). Some localities historically use a 225 sq ft Marla, so check your property documents.

How many Kanal are in one Acre?

One acre equals 8 Kanal, which is 160 Marla or 43,560 square feet.

What is a Gaj in land measurement?

Gaj is the local name for a square yard. One square yard equals 9 square feet, so 1 Marla is 30.25 Gaj.

Is 5 Marla a common plot size?

Yes — 5 Marla (1,361.25 sq ft), 10 Marla and 1 Kanal are the most common residential plot sizes in Pakistan.
